photos.desc: Reed canary grass growing at the north end of the Indreland Audubon Wetland Preserve, Bozeman, Gallatin County, Montana. Reed canary grass is likely the most abundant grass throughout these wetlands.
Nom français : alpiste roseau. Nom anglais : reed canarygrass. Épillet (glumes, glumelles) d'alpiste roseau.
The inflorescence is narrow and contracted early and late in the year, but during mid summer flowering, the panicle branches spread and the spike opens.
